# Shared editing actions

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/gen_actions_doc.py: do not edit by hand. -->

One catalogue of typed, validated edits of a SAEngine project, used by every surface: the command
line (`saengine action`, [docs/cli.md](cli.md#shared-editing-actions)), the SDK
(`saengine.api.list_actions` and `run_actions`, [docs/sdk](sdk/README.md)), the JSON-RPC
methods `actions/list` and `actions/run`, the app and its assistant. With it a script or the
assistant builds a whole project from an empty folder to the report.

- **A batch is all or nothing.** The steps run in order on one view of the project (a later step
  sees what an earlier one changed); when a step is refused, no change is returned or written.
- **Every value is checked** by the parameters' model, by the input guardrails (the same rules as
  the editors: `python/src/saengine/library/data/guardrails.json`, the code pack's limits) and by
  the part models: a changed part must still validate. Only what the step made worse counts; a
  problem the file had before stays the engineer's to fix. A refusal names the field, the value
  and the reason.
- **Kinds.** `edit` actions change part files only (the app applies the changes as one undo
  step); `run` actions work on the saved project (the app saves first; with `write` the edits
  before a run step are written first, and stay written if a later step fails); `query` actions
  read only.
- **Ids** are made as the floor plan editor makes them: the group's letter and the lowest free
  number (C1, B1, W1, S1, F1), LL1 and PL1 for line and point loads, BH-1 for boreholes.
- **Code independence.** No action branches on the code pack: the pack in force (the project's)
  gives the values (live loads, Ec, Es, wall weights, limits).
- Grid points are written `"A-1"` (X line, Y line) or `{"x": "A", "y": "1", "dx": 0, "dy": 0}`;
  lengths are in mm, loads in kN/m² (area), kN/m (line) and kN (point), stresses in MPa.

## Building a project from scratch

The order the assistant follows (`actions.help` returns it too):


1. project.create (name, codePack, occupancy; or building: a whole building at once)
2. settings.site, settings.use (site, use, loads); soil.borehole.add, soil.layer.add, soil.spt.add or soil.allowable_bearing.set
3. grid.set, storeys.set (typical: true for typical floors)
4. material.concrete.add (makeDefault) / material.steel.add for the project's materials; type.column.add, type.beam.add, type.slab.add (sizes)
5. columns.place, beams.place, slabs.place (points/between/panels "all"), walls.place
6. load.area.set, load.wall.add, load.line.add, load.point.add
7. run.step analyse, then foundations.generate (or footing.set)
8. run.all, design.reinforcement.apply, run.all again (checks with the bars)
9. results.summary, checks.list; export.report, export.drawings, export.boq

A batch file is a list of steps (or `{"steps": [...]}`); `python/tests/data/actions/three-storey-rc.json` builds, runs and designs a three-storey RC frame.

## Query

### `actions.help`

The catalogue: every action (or one, with its parameters' schema and an example), and the order to build a whole project in.

Kind: **query**. Parts: -.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string or null | null | One action: its parameters and example. |
| `kind` | "edit" or "run" or "query" or null | null |  |

```json
{"action": "actions.help", "params": {"name": "columns.place"}}
```

### `checks.list`

The members' design checks of the last run (by default only the failing ones), with their utilisation and governing check.

Kind: **query**. Parts: `fem`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `failing` | boolean | true | Only the members that fail a check. |
| `limit` | integer | 100 |  |

```json
{"action": "checks.list", "params": {"failing": true}}
```

### `members.list`

The floor plan's members (id, group, type, storey, where), filtered by group, storey or type.

Kind: **query**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | "columns" or "beams" or "walls" or "slabs" or "footings" or null | null |  |
| `storey` | string or null | null | Only the members on this storey. |
| `type` | string or null | null | Only members of this object type. |
| `limit` | integer | 500 |  |

```json
{"action": "members.list", "params": {"group": "columns", "storey": "L1"}}
```

### `project.summary`

What the project holds: code, site, use, grid, storeys, member counts, types, materials, area loads, foundations, soil.

Kind: **query**. Parts: `settings`, `materials`, `objects`, `floorPlan`, `loads`, `substructure`, `soil`.

No parameters.

```json
{"action": "project.summary", "params": {}}
```

### `results.summary`

The state of every part (as the sidebar shows it) and the design and foundation summaries of the last run.

Kind: **query**. Parts: `fem`, `substructure`.

No parameters.

```json
{"action": "results.summary", "params": {}}
```

## Project

### `building.generate`

Generate a whole building (grid, storeys, materials, types, members, footings) into the project from a BuildingSpec; the settings' code pack and site are kept.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`, `materials`, `objects`, `floorPlan`, `bim`, `substructure`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `building` | object | required | The generator's BuildingSpec: gridsX and gridsY spacings [mm], storyCount (or stories), system, footing, concrete, rebar, occupancy, ... |
| `replace` | boolean | false | Replace the members already on the floor plan (else refused when there are). |

```json
{"action": "building.generate", "params": {"building": {"gridsX": [5000, 5000, 5000], "gridsY": [4000, 4000], "storyCount": 3}}}
```

### `project.create`

Create a project in the folder: empty (then grid, storeys, members...) or a whole building from a grid and storeys (building: the generator's spec).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`, `materials`, `objects`, `floorPlan`, `bim`, `substructure`, `soil`, `mep`, `boq`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required | The project's name. |
| `codePack` | string or null | null | Id of the design code pack (codes/list); none: the default. |
| `location` | string or null | null | Town of the pack's hazard tables, or custom. |
| `siteClass` | string or null | null | One of the pack's site classes. |
| `occupancy` | "residential" or "office" or "educational" or "healthcare" or "assembly" or "retail" or "industrial" or "storage" or "parking" or "mixed" or null | null | The building's use. |
| `units` | "SI" or "USCustomary" or null | null | Display units; none: the pack's suggestion. |
| `building` | object or null | null | A whole building from a grid and storeys (the generator's BuildingSpec: gridsX, gridsY spacings [mm], storyCount or stories, system, footing, ...); none: an empty project (then grid.set, storeys.set, ...). |

```json
{"action": "project.create", "params": {"name": "Example House", "occupancy": "residential"}}
```

## Settings

### `settings.analysis`

Set analysis model options (the names of Project Settings > Analysis model).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `set` | object | required | Analysis options of 02 Project Settings > Analysis model by their names (e.g. slabs, diaphragm, meshSize, supports, responseSpectrum, secondOrder, liveLoadReduction, seismicDesign); objects are merged, null resets an option. |

```json
{"action": "settings.analysis", "params": {"set": {"diaphragm": "rigid", "meshSize": 500}}}
```

### `settings.code_pack`

Switch the project to another design code pack: its towns, site classes, systems, area loads and combinations take the pack's values.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codePack` | string | required | Id of an installed code pack (codes/list). |

```json
{"action": "settings.code_pack", "params": {"codePack": "bnbc2020"}}
```

### `settings.site`

Set the site: location, site class, seismic zone coefficient, wind speed and exposure, mapped spectral values, seismic system, ground level and the allowable bearing pressure when there is no soil report.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `location` | string or null | null | Town of the pack's hazard tables (sets Z and V), or custom. |
| `siteClass` | string or null | null | One of the pack's site classes. |
| `siteClassSource` | "soilReport" or "entered" or null | null | soilReport: the soil report's class once its boreholes give one; entered: this class. Default with siteClass: entered. |
| `zoneCoefficient` | number or null | null | Z: overrides the town's [g]; null: the town's again. |
| `windSpeed` | number or null | null | Basic wind speed [m/s]: overrides the town's; null: the town's. |
| `windExposure` | string or null | null | Exposure or terrain category of the pack's wind table. |
| `spectral` | object or null | null | Mapped spectral values (sds, sd1, s1, tl) for a pack with mapped spectra. |
| `altitude` | number or null | null | Site altitude [m]. |
| `seismicSystem` | string or null | null | The seismic force-resisting system (one of the pack's). |
| `groundLevel` | number or null | null | Finished ground level [mm]. |
| `allowableBearing` | number or null | null | Net allowable bearing pressure qa [kPa] for every footing when there is no soil report (overrides it); null: from the soil report again. |

```json
{"action": "settings.site", "params": {"location": "dhaka", "siteClass": "SD", "windExposure": "B"}}
```

### `settings.use`

Set the building's use and occupancy category, and the floor and roof area loads (live loads default to the pack's for the use).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `occupancy` | "residential" or "office" or "educational" or "healthcare" or "assembly" or "retail" or "industrial" or "storage" or "parking" or "mixed" or null | null | The building's use. |
| `category` | "I" or "II" or "III" or "IV" or null | null | Occupancy (risk) category. |
| `floorUse` | string or null | null | Area use of the floors' area load (one of the pack's area uses); default: the occupancy's. |
| `floorLive` | number or null | null | Floor live load [kN/m²]; default: the pack's for the use. |
| `floorFinish` | number or null | null | Floor finish SD [kN/m²]. |
| `partitions` | number or null | null | Partition allowance [kN/m²]. |
| `roofLive` | number or null | null | Roof live load Lr [kN/m²]. |
| `roofFinish` | number or null | null | Roof finish SD [kN/m²]. |

```json
{"action": "settings.use", "params": {"occupancy": "office", "floorFinish": 1.5}}
```

## Soil

### `soil.allowable_bearing.set`

Set the net allowable bearing pressure qa used for every footing (when there is no soil report, or to override it); null to use the soil report's again.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number or null | required | Net allowable bearing pressure qa [kPa] for every footing; null: take qa per footing from the soil report again. |

```json
{"action": "soil.allowable_bearing.set", "params": {"value": 150}}
```

### `soil.borehole.add`

Add a borehole to the soil report at a plan position.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `soil`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string or null | null | E.g. BH-1; default: the next free BH-n. |
| `x` | number | required | Position in the project's plan [mm]. |
| `y` | number | required | Position in the project's plan [mm]. |
| `groundLevel` | number or null | null | Ground level at the hole [mm]. |
| `waterTable` | number or null | null | Depth of the water table below the ground [mm]. |
| `depth` | number or null | null | Depth drilled [mm]. |
| `date` | string or null | null |  |
| `method` | string or null | null |  |

```json
{"action": "soil.borehole.add", "params": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "waterTable": 2000, "depth": 15000}}
```

### `soil.layer.add`

Add a soil layer (stratum) to a borehole's log.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `soil`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `borehole` | string | required | Borehole id. |
| `top` | number | required | Depth of the top below the borehole's ground [mm]. |
| `bottom` | number | required | Depth of the bottom [mm]. |
| `soilType` | "clay" or "silt" or "sand" or "gravel" or "organic" or "fill" or "rock" | required |  |
| `description` | string | "" |  |
| `uscs` | string or null | null | USCS group, e.g. CL, SM. |
| `unitWeight` | number or null | null | [kN/m³] |
| `cu` | number or null | null | Undrained shear strength [kPa]. |
| `c` | number or null | null | Cohesion c' [kPa]. |
| `phi` | number or null | null | Friction angle [°]. |
| `more` | object | null | Other fields of the layer (the soil report's names). |

```json
{"action": "soil.layer.add", "params": {"borehole": "BH-1", "top": 0, "bottom": 3000, "soilType": "clay", "cu": 40}}
```

### `soil.spt.add`

Add a standard penetration test record (N, or the 150 mm increments) to a borehole.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `soil`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `borehole` | string | required | Borehole id. |
| `depth` | number | required | Depth of the test below the borehole's ground [mm]. |
| `N` | integer or null | null | Field blow count [blows/300 mm]. |
| `seat` | integer or null | null | Blows for the first 150 mm. |
| `N1` | integer or null | null | Blows for the second 150 mm. |
| `N2` | integer or null | null | Blows for the third 150 mm. |
| `more` | object | null | Other fields of the record. |

```json
{"action": "soil.spt.add", "params": {"borehole": "BH-1", "depth": 1500, "N": 8}}
```

## Grid and storeys

### `grid.line.add`

Add a grid line on the X or Y axis at a position.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | "x" or "y" | required |  |
| `position` | number | required | [mm] from the origin. |
| `label` | string or null | null | Default: the next free label. |

```json
{"action": "grid.line.add", "params": {"axis": "x", "position": 20000}}
```

### `grid.line.delete`

Delete a grid line (with the members on it only when deleteMembers is true).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`, `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | required |  |
| `deleteMembers` | boolean | false | Also delete the members on the line (else refused when there are any). |

```json
{"action": "grid.line.delete", "params": {"label": "D"}}
```

### `grid.line.move`

Move a grid line to a position (or by a distance); members on it move with it.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | required |  |
| `position` | number or null | null | New position [mm]. |
| `by` | number or null | null | Or: move by this much [mm]. |

```json
{"action": "grid.line.move", "params": {"label": "B", "position": 5500}}
```

### `grid.set`

Set the whole grid: the X and Y lines by their spacings (or labels and positions).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | list of number or list of GridLineIn | required | X lines (vertical in plan, labelled A, B, ...): the spacings between them [mm], or the lines as {label, position}. |
| `y` | list of number or list of GridLineIn | required | Y lines (labelled 1, 2, ...): the spacings [mm], or {label, position}. |
| `origin` | list of number | [0, 0] | Position of the first lines [mm]. |

```json
{"action": "grid.set", "params": {"x": [5000, 5000, 5000], "y": [4000, 4000]}}
```

### `storey.add`

Add a storey on top (or above a given storey, lifting the ones above it).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | number | required | Height of the new storey [mm]. |
| `name` | string or null | null |  |
| `id` | string or null | null |  |
| `above` | string or null | null | Insert above this storey (the ones higher up move up); default: on top. |

```json
{"action": "storey.add", "params": {"height": 3000, "name": "Roof"}}
```

### `storey.delete`

Delete a storey; the storeys above come down by its height. Members on it are deleted only when deleteMembers is true.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`, `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required |  |
| `deleteMembers` | boolean | false | Also delete the members on it (else refused when there are). |

```json
{"action": "storey.delete", "params": {"id": "L3"}}
```

### `storey.height`

Change a storey's height (the distance from the storey below); the ones above move.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required | The storey whose height (from the storey below) changes. |
| `height` | number | required | New height [mm]. |

```json
{"action": "storey.height", "params": {"id": "L1", "height": 3600}}
```

### `storey.typical`

Make storeys typical floors of a master storey (similarTo): their plan becomes a copy of the master's, and later edits on one are made on all.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`, `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `master` | string | required | The storey whose plan the others repeat. |
| `storeys` | list of string | required | The storeys made similar to it. |
| `copy` | boolean | true | Replace their columns, beams, walls and slabs with copies of the master's. |

```json
{"action": "storey.typical", "params": {"master": "L2", "storeys": ["L3"]}}
```

### `storeys.set`

Set all the storeys: a base level and the storeys above it with their heights.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storeys` | list of StoreyIn or null | null | The storeys from the bottom, each with its height [mm]. |
| `count` | integer or null | null | Or: this many storeys ... |
| `height` | number or null | null | ... of this height [mm] ... |
| `groundHeight` | number or null | null | ... the lowest of this height (default: height). |
| `baseElevation` | number | 0 | Level of the base [mm]. |
| `baseName` | string | "Base" |  |
| `typical` | boolean | false | Storeys above the second level are similar to the second (typical floors, as the New Project wizard makes them). |

```json
{"action": "storeys.set", "params": {"count": 3, "height": 3000, "typical": true}}
```

## Materials and object types

### `material.concrete.add`

Add a concrete by its f'c (Ec by the code pack); optionally the project's concrete.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `materials`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fc` | number | required | Specified compressive strength f'c [MPa]. |
| `id` | string or null | null | Default: C<f'c>. |
| `name` | string or null | null |  |
| `density` | number | 2400.0 | [kg/m³] |
| `maxAggregate` | number or null | 20 | [mm] |
| `E` | number or null | null | [MPa]; default: the pack's Ec of f'c. |
| `makeDefault` | boolean | false | Make it the project's concrete (types without their own). |

```json
{"action": "material.concrete.add", "params": {"fc": 28, "makeDefault": true}}
```

### `material.concrete.set`

Change a concrete (f'c, density, Ec, name); Ec follows a new f'c unless given.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `materials`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required |  |
| `fc` | number or null | null | [MPa]; Ec follows unless E is given. |
| `name` | string or null | null |  |
| `density` | number or null | null |  |
| `maxAggregate` | number or null | null |  |
| `E` | number or null | null |  |
| `makeDefault` | boolean or null | null |  |

```json
{"action": "material.concrete.set", "params": {"id": "C24.1", "fc": 25}}
```

### `material.steel.add`

Add reinforcing bars or a structural steel by fy (Es by the code pack).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `materials`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | "rebar" or "steel" | required | rebar: reinforcing bars; steel: structural steel. |
| `fy` | number | required | Yield strength [MPa]. |
| `fu` | number or null | null | Tensile strength [MPa]. |

| `name` | string or null | null |  |
| `makeDefault` | boolean | false | Rebar: make it the project's bars. |

```json
{"action": "material.steel.add", "params": {"kind": "rebar", "fy": 500, "grade": "B500DWR"}}
```

### `material.steel.set`

Change reinforcing bars or a structural steel (fy, fu, grade, name).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required |  |

| `fu` | number or null | null |  |
| `grade` | string or null | null |  |
| `name` | string or null | null |  |

## Members

### `beams.place`

Place beams between grid points (pairs, or all along the grid lines) on storeys.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | required | Object type id (04 Objects). |
| `between` | "all" or list of list of string or GridPointIn | "all" | Pairs of grid points [["A-1", "B-1"], ...], or "all": between every two neighbouring intersections along every grid line. |
| `lines` | list of string or null | null | With "all": only along these grid lines (labels). |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string | "all" | The storeys (ids), or "all" (every storey above the lowest); a typical floor brings its whole family. |

```json
{"action": "beams.place", "params": {"type": "B250x450", "between": "all", "storeys": "all"}}
```

### `columns.place`

Place columns at grid points (a list, or all) on storeys; each rises from the storey below.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | required | Column object type id (04 Objects). |
| `points` | "all" or list of string or GridPointIn | "all" | Grid points ("A-1" or {x, y, dx, dy}), or "all". |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string | "all" | The storeys (ids), or "all" (every storey above the lowest); a typical floor brings its whole family. |
| `rotation` | number | 0 | Rotation of the section [°]. |

```json
{"action": "columns.place", "params": {"type": "C400x400", "points": "all", "storeys": "all"}}
```

### `member.delete`

Delete members (and the member loads on them); on a typical floor their twins on the family's other storeys too.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`, `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | list of string | required | Member ids. |
| `thisStoreyOnly` | boolean | false | On a typical floor: delete only these, not their twins on the family's other storeys. |

```json
{"action": "member.delete", "params": {"ids": ["B3"]}}
```

### `member.set`

Change members: object type, rotation, offsets, storeys (base/top or story), a slab's area load; on a typical floor the family's twins follow.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | list of string | required | Member ids. |
| `type` | string or null | null | Another object type of its kind. |
| `rotation` | number or null | null | Columns, footings [°]. |
| `dx` | number or null | null | Columns: offset from the grid point [mm]. |
| `dy` | number or null | null | Columns: offset [mm]. |
| `base` | string or null | null | Columns, walls: the storey it starts at. |
| `top` | string or null | null | Columns, walls: the storey it ends at. |
| `story` | string or null | null | Beams, slabs: its storey. |
| `areaLoad` | string or null | null | Slabs: area load id. |
| `thisStoreyOnly` | boolean | false | On a typical floor: change only these members, not their twins on the family's other storeys (type, rotation, offsets and area load follow the family). |

```json
{"action": "member.set", "params": {"ids": ["C1"], "type": "C450x450", "rotation": 90}}
```

### `members.copy_to_storeys`

Copy a storey's columns, beams, walls and slabs to other storeys (places that have one already are left as they are).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | required | The storey to copy from. |
| `to` | list of string | required | The storeys to copy to. |
| `groups` | list of "columns" or "beams" or "walls" or "slabs" | ["columns", "beams", "walls", "slabs"] | Which members. |

```json
{"action": "members.copy_to_storeys", "params": {"from": "L1", "to": ["L2", "L3"]}}
```

### `slabs.place`

Place slabs in grid bays (by their lower-left point, corner lists, or all) on storeys.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | required | Slab object type id (04 Objects). |
| `panels` | "all" or list of string or GridPointIn or list of string or GridPointIn | "all" | The bays by their lower-left grid point ("A-1": the bay A-B, 1-2), or corner lists (at least 3 points in order), or "all". |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string | "all" | The storeys (ids), or "all" (every storey above the lowest); a typical floor brings its whole family. |
| `areaLoad` | string or null | null | Area load id of 02 Project Settings; none: the floor's or roof's. |

```json
{"action": "slabs.place", "params": {"type": "S125", "panels": "all", "storeys": "all"}}
```

### `walls.place`

Place walls between grid points on storeys; each rises from the storey below.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | required | Object type id (04 Objects). |
| `between` | "all" or list of list of string or GridPointIn | "all" | Pairs of grid points [["A-1", "B-1"], ...], or "all": between every two neighbouring intersections along every grid line. |
| `lines` | list of string or null | null | With "all": only along these grid lines (labels). |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string | "all" | The storeys (ids), or "all" (every storey above the lowest); a typical floor brings its whole family. |

```json
{"action": "walls.place", "params": {"type": "W200", "between": [["A-1", "B-1"]], "storeys": ["L1"]}}
```

## Loads

### `load.area.set`

Set an area load (SD, L or Lr, partitions) and assign it to the slabs of storeys or to slabs; without a target it changes the area load itself (e.g. FL, RF).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `settings`, `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string or null | null | The area load to set (e.g. FL floors, RF roof); a new id makes a new one. Default: a new area load AL<n> when storeys or slabs are given. |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string or null | null | Assign it to every slab of these storeys. |
| `slabs` | list of string or null | null | Or: to these slabs (ids). |
| `name` | string or null | null |  |
| `use` | string or null | null | Area use (one of the pack's). |
| `SD` | number or null | null | Superimposed dead load (finish) [kN/m²]. |
| `L` | number or null | null | Live load [kN/m²]. |
| `Lr` | number or null | null | Roof live load [kN/m²] (an area load of roof use). |
| `partitions` | number or null | null | Partition allowance [kN/m²]. |

```json
{"action": "load.area.set", "params": {"id": "FL", "SD": 1.5, "L": 2.0}}
```

### `load.line.add`

Add a uniform line load [kN/m] on beams (by id, or every beam of storeys).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beams` | list of string or null | null | Beam ids. |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string or null | null | Or: every beam of these storeys. |
| `value` | number | required | Uniform load [kN/m, down]. |
| `case` | "D" or "SD" or "L" or "Lr" | "SD" | Load case: D, SD, L or Lr. |
| `thisStoryOnly` | boolean | false | On a typical floor: only this storey, not its family. |
| `note` | string | "" |  |

```json
{"action": "load.line.add", "params": {"beams": ["B1"], "value": 5, "case": "SD"}}
```

### `load.point.add`

Add a point load [kN] on a beam (at a distance from its start) or at a column's joint.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `member` | string | required | A beam id (with distance) or a column id (a joint load). |
| `value` | number | required | [kN, down] |
| `distance` | number or null | null | Beams: from its start [mm]. |
| `story` | string or null | null | Columns: the storey of the joint (default: the column's top). |
| `case` | "D" or "SD" or "L" or "Lr" | "SD" |  |
| `thisStoryOnly` | boolean | false |  |
| `note` | string | "" |  |

```json
{"action": "load.point.add", "params": {"member": "B1", "value": 20, "distance": 2500, "case": "L"}}
```

### `load.wall.add`

Add masonry wall loads on beams: a wall type of the pack's dead loads with its height (or the storey height less the beam above) and openings.

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `loads`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beams` | list of string or null | null | Beam ids the walls stand on. |
| `storeys` | "all" or list of string or null | null | Or: every beam of these storeys. |
| `wallType` | string or null | null | Wall type id of loads.json (the pack's masonry walls); default: the first. |
| `height` | number or null | null | Wall height [mm]; none: worked out per storey (auto). |
| `openings` | number | 0 | Doors and windows, % of the wall's face. |
| `skipRoof` | boolean | false | Auto height: no parapet on the top storey. |
| `thisStoryOnly` | boolean | false |  |

```json
{"action": "load.wall.add", "params": {"storeys": "all", "openings": 20}}
```

## Foundations

### `footing.set`

Place or change a footing under columns (size, thickness, material).

Kind: **edit**. Parts: `substructure`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string or null | null | An existing foundation to change; or new. |
| `type` | "isolated" or "combined" | "isolated" |  |
| `columns` | list of string or null | null | Column ids it carries (at their base). |
| `at` | string or GridPointIn or null | null | Or: the grid point of the column it carries (lowest storey). |
| `length` | number or null | null | Along x [mm]. |
| `width` | number or null | null | Along y [mm]. |
| `thickness` | number or null | null | [mm] |
| `rotation` | number or null | null | [°] |
| `material` | string or null | null | Concrete id; default: the project's. |

```json
{"action": "footing.set", "params": {"at": "A-1", "length": 1500, "width": 1500, "thickness": 450}}
```

### `foundations.generate`

Size footings for the column bases from the analysis reactions and the soil (Size Footings); needs the analysis results (run.step analyse first).

Kind: **run**. Parts: `substructure`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | list of string or null | null | Column ids to size footings for; default: every column base without a foundation. |
| `replace` | boolean | false | With columns: size them again even if they have one. |

```json
{"action": "foundations.generate", "params": {}}
```

## Run and export

### `design.reinforcement.apply`

Design Reinforcement: propose bars for the object types from the analysis and apply them (all types, or those given); needs the analysis results. Never automatic.

Kind: **run**. Parts: `objects`, `bim`, `floorPlan`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `types` | "all" or list of string | "all" | Object type ids to give the proposed bars, or "all". |
| `members` | list of string or null | null | Or: the types of these members (ids). |
| `mode` | "byType" or "splitTypes" | "byType" | byType: one set of bars per type; splitTypes: members much lighter than their type's governing one get new types. |

```json
{"action": "design.reinforcement.apply", "params": {"types": "all"}}
```

### `run.all`

Run All: building model, analysis model, analysis, foundations, design checks, MEP, bill of quantities, report and drawings, as the app's Run All.


### `run.step`

Run part of Run All: derive (the analysis model), analyse, design (members and foundations), substructure, boq, report or drawings.

Kind: **run**. Parts: `bim`, `fem`, `substructure`, `boq`, `exports`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `step` | "derive" or "analyse" or "design" or "substructure" or "boq" or "report" or "drawings" | required |  |
| `strict` | boolean | true | Fail the action when a step fails. |

```json
{"action": "run.step", "params": {"step": "analyse"}}
```
